title: VERITAS-ES-MADM: Computational materials for claim verification and decision-readiness monitoring
description: Computational implementation and reproducible case-study materials for VERITAS-ES-MADM, a fuzzy entropy–synergy multicriteria decision-readiness framework for claim verification under uncertain and conflicting evidence.
